# Related Links

> [!NOTE]
> Please replace this note with links to discussions (including vouching) and other issues or related pull requests. If there are no links, you can remove this section.

# Checklist

All items are required unless otherwise stated.

- [ ] I have read and comprehend the [CONTRIBUTING] guidelines.
- [ ] I have read and comprehend the [genAI/LLM Policy].
- [ ] My pull request has been [vouched](https://github.com/gpui-ce/gpui-ce/discussions/categories/vouch-request), and I know that unvouched requests are automatically closed.
- [ ] I have updated the [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/gpui-ce/gpui-ce/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md). Leave unchecked if you feel the changelog does not need updating (e.g. doesn't affect external API, doesn't fix a bug, and doesn't meaningfully change functionality - like adding examples).
- [ ] I have added/updated tests to cover my changes. If leaving unchecked, please state in `Overview` why you feel that tests are not practical or necessary for this change.
- [ ] I used LLMs to write code or other text (either in the commits or in this pull request description). Leave unchecked if LLMs were not used.

[CONTRIBUTING]: https://github.com/gpui-ce/gpui-ce/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
[genAI/LLM Policy]: https://github.com/gpui-ce/gpui-ce/blob/main/AI_POLICY.md
